column3: The request is to stand surety for the servant for good.
The eyes’ failing is expressed as completed.
The precepts are regarded as right, with a repeated “all.”
My soul is explicitly the subject of keeping, expressed as completed.
Opening, panting, and longing are expressed as completed.
The comparison is with the judgment or customary right of those who love Your name.
The streams are of water; they have not kept Your law, an active plural clause.
The image is of a greatly refined utterance; the clauses are linked by “and.”
Not forgetting is expressed as completed.
Your righteousness is righteousness forever, preserving the repeated noun.
Coming before and crying for help are expressed as completed; dawn is not explicitly named.
Drawing near and distancing themselves are expressed as completed.
